description: Split a text (for example an AI-generated answer) into atomic factual claims. Each claim includes span, grounding_required, claim_type (number|date|quantity|quote|named_entity_fact|comparison|opinion|prediction|other), check_worthiness (high|medium|low), and the source sentence. Hedges are stripped, pronouns are resolved across sentences, and compound sentences are split. Questions, greetings, opinions and predictions are marked grounding_required false. Use before verify_claim. Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions and POST /v1/extract_claims returns the claims. Read-only.

text.description: The text to split into claims, for example a chatbot answer. Up to a few thousand characters.
examples: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris and was completed in 1889.
